from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-369424df.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    rare = set(counts) - set(common)

    # Colored points lie at intersections of the hidden cell grid's borders.
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in rare for v in row)]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in rare for r in range(h))]

    # On marked border rows, the more common of the two background colors is
    # the separator color; the other is the repeated cell fill.
    border_counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in range(w)
                            if grid[r][c] in common)
    background = border_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill = common[0] if common[1] == background else common[1]

    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(col_lines)-1)] for _ in range(len(row_lines)-1)]
    for i in range(len(row_lines)-1):
        for j in range(len(col_lines)-1):
            y0, y1 = row_lines[i], row_lines[i+1]
            x0, x1 = col_lines[j], col_lines[j+1]
            corners = (grid[y0][x0], grid[y0][x1], grid[y1][x0], grid[y1][x1])
            if corners[0] not in (background, fill) and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
